context.body: Jesus names, forgives, bears, and sends · John 5:1–18
context.label: Jesus names, forgives, bears, and sends

observations.body: Jesus heals a man, later tells him to sin no more, and does not give a general cause for the man’s former illness.
observations.label: Made well, then told to sin no more

observations.body: The passage presents saving, forgiving, taking away, convicting, sending, bearing, dying, rising, and making free as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: saving, forgiving, taking away, convicting, sending, bearing, dying, rising, and making free

observations.body: The passage places christ spirit and authority beside saving, forgiving, taking away, convicting, sending, bearing, dying, rising, and making free.
observations.label: christ spirit and authority

payload.posture: Read John 5:1–18 as evidence about sin, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the source states a relation among sin, Jesus Christ, the Spirit, faith, death, or life without supplying one complete theory
payload.title: Made well, then told to sin no more
